notes: MADToken (src/MADToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin Contracts v5.1.0. name() returns "Mutually Assured Destruction", symbol() returns "MAD" and decimals() returns 18. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 MAD (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory; no mint path exists afterwards. There is no owner, no Ownable, no pause, no blocklist, no freeze, no transfer fee, no burn-on-transfer, no reflection and no exemption list, so every launch flow (factory to MerkleDistributor, seed through the PoolManager, claims, buys and sells) moves exactly the amount requested. Because the token taxes nothing it does not need $factory, $poolManager or $launchNumber and takes none. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT and no proxy. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The pool pairs with IMD at the launch policy's 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60; initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
